gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Recurrent Glioblastoma; Glioblastoma Multiforme of Brain
Diagnosis of a new intra-axial brain mass that is consistent with GBM per the opinion of a Penn neuroradiologist.

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a non-therapeutic trial in that imaging will not be used to direct treatment decisions.
[DRUG] Fluciclovine F18: To perform metabolic phenotyping of treatment naïve and recurrent GBM by multitracer \[18F\]Fluciclovine and 18F-FDG PET.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: To perform metabolic phenotyping of treatment naïve and recurrent GBM by multitracer \[18F\]Fluciclovine and 18F-FDG PET.

role_evidence.quote: Quantification of \[18F\]Fluciclovine and 18F-FDG uptake values (SUV) in treatment naïve and recurrent GBM.

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-labelled amino acid PET imaging tracer (fluciclovine F-18)

role_evidence.quote: Subsequently, the subjects will undergo injection of up to 10 mCi of 18F-FDG followed by a static 20-minute scan approximately 60 minutes post injection

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour gene expression of glutamine and glucose metabolism (RNA seq/proteomics)

source_quote.quote: Correlation of PET uptake values (SUV) and kinetic parameters (volume of distribution) with gene expression of glutamine and glucose metabolism.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 imaging-only study; no therapeutic agent. 18F-FDG is not a registered intervention but every subject receives it per protocol, so listed as diagnostic agent. cns5 coded historical because conditions use 'Glioblastoma Multiforme'.
